name: Smartli
summary: AI writing suite for e-commerce: product listings, ad copy, SEO text and brand assets. Each of the nine tools is competent rather than deep, so leaning hard on one job means outgrowing it.
best_for: e-commerce sellers who want an affordable AI suite to draft product listings, ad copy, SEO text and basic brand assets in one place
skip_if: you need real depth in one area (a specialist copy or image tool), or you won't edit and fact-check AI output before it ships
honest_knock:
Smartli bundles nine AI tools (copy, SEO, images, logos) into one suite, and that breadth is also the honest catch: each individual tool is competent rather than the best at its job, so a team that leans hard on one job may outgrow it toward a specialist. And like all AI copy, its product descriptions and ad copy need a human edit and a fact-check: never publish specs or claims it invents about your product. For a store that wants many content jobs handled cheaply in one place, it's efficient.

Two places tell different stories about trying it for free. The Shopify App Store listing, read on 27 October 2026, says 'Free plan available' and shows a Free card that lists only 24/7 chat support, while smartli.ai/pricing shows four paid tiers and no free plan on either tab. A one-star review from an Australian store, edited 24 July 2024, says the advertised free account was not offered after installing and the app would not allow a test without choosing a plan. If a free tier matters to you, note that in our own test of 17 November 2026 the app offered no free route after installing and went to a card checkout on smartli.ai instead of a Shopify charge screen.

The star average hides a split. Of 66 ratings, 53 are five stars and 4 are one star (4.0 overall), and the one- and two-star reviews are nearly all about billing rather than writing quality: a charge after cancelling inside the trial (May 2023), the free-account complaint above, and the November 2025 review about a $152 charge on the install day. Smartli's terms add that a failed monthly payment may be retried on the same card until you cancel or change the payment method in your account settings, so an expired card does not end the subscription.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month, monthly only (drops on annual billing)
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on apps.shopify.com/smartli-ai-product-description and in our own test that day; earlier: re-verified 2026-09-11 and re-read 2026-09-27 on smartli.ai/pricing; Monthly and Yearly tabs both unchanged since 5 Aug 2026) Monthly: Starter $39, Pro $59, Empire $99, Unicorn $299, each with a 7-day free trial. Switch to annual billing and Starter disappears from the table; the rest become Pro $24/mo (billed annually at $288), Empire $57/mo ($684) and Unicorn $79/mo ($948). Starter was $29/mo when we first checked, so the entry price has gone up. Re-read on 27 October 2026 with a plain fetch: smartli.ai/pricing unchanged (monthly Starter $39, Pro $59, Empire $99, Unicorn $299, each with a 7-day trial; yearly Pro $24 billed $288, Empire $57 billed $684, Unicorn $79 billed $948, Starter absent). The Shopify App Store listing, now titled 'Smartli: AI Tools & SEO Writer', shows a Free plan card with 24/7 chat support above the same paid tiers, and says all charges are billed in USD every 30 days. Re-read on 16 November 2026 with a plain fetch: the same monthly $39, $59, $99 and $299 with a 7-day trial each, and the same yearly $288, $684 and $948 in the page's data; Smartli's help centre now gives the monthly range as $39 to $299. Read again on 17 November 2026: the listing is now titled Smartli: AI Writer, Logo & SEO and shows a Free card with 24/7 chat support above Starter $39 (20 SEO optimized descriptions a month), Pro $59 (100 descriptions and 10 AI blog posts) and Empire $99 (1,000 descriptions and 50 blog posts), each with a 7 day trial, at 4.1 from 66 reviews. In our own test the same day on a Shopify development store the install screen called the app “ChatGPT: 6 AI Tools in 1”, and the free plan on the listing did not appear: setup led to a checkout page on app.smartli.ai, not to a Shopify billing screen, and skipping setup led to the same page. It listed Monthly Starter $39, Pro $59, Empire $99, preselected and marked Most Popular, and Unicorn $299, each shown with its monthly price struck through next to $1, with a yearly tab advertising up to 5 months off. The total due now read $0 with a button saying Claim Your Trial, and the page asked for a card or Google Pay. A box to add AI generated keywords for $19 after the 7 day trial was ticked in advance, and a notice with a countdown said only 26 trial spots were left that month. We entered no card, so we could not see what the $1 is charged as.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session installed Smartli on a Shopify development store. Skip setup and the side menu both led to the Smartli checkout, which showed four paid plans at $1, a default ticked add-on and a card form with $0 due now, and no free plan, so no description was generated. The app was uninstalled; nothing was entered or paid. Install: the install form was sent at about 23:29; the Shopify screen Install app named the app ChatGPT: 6 AI Tools in 1 (Innovation Labs.) and asked for View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data. The app opened on its own site, logged in through Shopify, on Step 1 of 3: What do you want Smartli to create for you? with a Skip setup button. Core action NOT DONE: Skip setup led to the Smartli checkout, and the AI Descriptions item in the side menu sent us back to the onboarding and plan page. The description generator was not reached. Checkout: the own checkout of Smartli, Pay Securely, Cancel anytime, not a Shopify approval screen, so there is no Shopify test charge. Monthly: Starter $39, Pro $59, Empire $99 (Most Popular, preselected) and Unicorn $299, each struck through to $1; Yearly says up to 5 months off. No free plan was offered. On the right: Select payment method with a card form (card number, expiry date, security code) and Google Pay, Total amount now $0 and the button Claim Your Trial. A box was ticked by default: Get access to AI-generated keywords for $19 after a 7-day trial. A banner said Limited Spots Available: Only 26 trial spots left this month due to high demand, with a countdown. Nothing was entered. Dossier question: the Free plan on the listing gave no free route after the install; the app requires a paid plan with a card, so the number of free descriptions is unknown. Cancelling: no subscription existed. Only the Shopify uninstall dialog was seen, with a required reason (Testing multiple apps). Clean up: the app was uninstalled and is gone from Installed; no products, collections or themes were changed. Our own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The app sends every route to its own checkout; the Free plan on the listing was not offered, a $19 add-on is ticked by default, and a countdown says only 26 trial spots are left.
